entries.claim: Directs the celebrant, after the preceding chants and before the Gospel greeting, to say Munda cor meum, Iube Domine benedicere and Dominus sit in corde meo secreto. This supports the priest actor, quiet voice and placement, not a full-body transcription or a general omission rule.
